observations: Photo 0 shows a white vertical console with a black center panel and a disc slot on the left edge, standing on a wooden surface next to a white gamepad with black analog sticks.
Photo 1 shows the same console from the front with the same gamepad in front of it; a framed J. Cole poster hangs on the wall behind both.
Both photos carry a "POSTED ON JIJI ABIODUN JAMES" watermark.

claims.evidence: No readable brand or model text appears on the console in photo 0 or photo 1.
Photo 0 and photo 1 show a clean exterior with no visible damage.
A white controller is visible beside the console in photo 0 and in front of it in photo 1.

risks.risk: Console does not power on or display video
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to a TV or monitor home screen

risks.risk: Controller buttons, analog sticks, or wireless connection are faulty
risks.proof: Video of the controller paired to the console with all inputs tested

risks.risk: Disc drive does not accept, read, or eject discs
risks.proof: Video of a disc being inserted, read, and ejected

risks.risk: Console is account-locked, banned, or not factory-reset
risks.proof: Screenshot or video showing the account is signed out and the system is reset

proof_requests: Video of the console turning on and showing the home screen on a TV
Video of the controller connected and all buttons and sticks tested
Video of a disc inserted, read, and ejected
Screenshot or video proving the console is signed out and factory-reset
response.reason: The item is identifiable from the photos as a home game console with controller, so it can be priced at its worst case (not working) without further proof.
